column1: Caster can tell the exact dimensions, mass, and/or weight of one object.
column2: Target gains double normal hearing. The results in +50 to Perception involving only hearing, +25 to Perception involving hearing and other senses.
column3: Target may add +50 to any manuever rolls for one slow maneuver (e.g., walking a 3'' beam).
column4: Target can see 100' on a normal night as if it were daylight. See Section 7.1.19.
column5: Target has a 300 degree field of vision. The flank bonus for attacks against the target is lowered to +5 and the rear bonus is lowered to +15.
column6: Target’s voice has its loudness tripled. This has no effect on spell casting capabilities (it simply allows the caster to make himself heard without difficulty over long distances).
column7: As Nightvision, except target can see 100' in even murky water.
column8: Target can breathe water but not air.
column9: As Nightvision, except target can see varying degrees of heat on the surfaces of objects. This spell does not allow the caster to see ''through'' things. While this vision is sufficient for moving around, it is not sufficient at all for reading or mapping.
column10: As Waterlungs, except target can breathe any gas as normal air.
column11: Delays the effect of a poison on a target. If poison is not eliminated before the spell expires, the target will be affected by the poison at that time.
column12: As Nightvision, except any darkness can be seen through. Also, no light is needed at all for this spell to work.
column13: As Waterlungs, except target can breathe water, air, and/or any gas at will.
column14: As Balance, except can affect one target per level of caster.
column15: As Nightvision, except can affect one target per level of caster.
column16: As Watervision, except can affect one target/level of caster.
column17: As all ''vision'' spells below 15th level functioning at the same time.
column18: As Waterlungs, except can affect 1 target per level of caster.
column19: As Gaslungs, except can affect 1 target per level of caster.
column20: As Vision, except can affect 1 target per level of caster.
